name: temperature
description: Sampling randomness. Qwen3 advises against greedy decoding in thinking mode, so the window stops at 0.2.

name: top_p
description: Cumulative probability mass considered for sampling.

name: top_k
description: Number of candidate tokens; zero or minus one disables filtering.

name: repetition_penalty
description: Penalty for tokens present in the prompt or generated text; below 1 favours repetition.

name: frequency_penalty
description: Penalty scaled by token frequency in generated text.

name: presence_penalty
description: Penalty for tokens already present in generated text.

name: min_p
description: Minimum token probability relative to the most likely token.

name: ignore_eos
description: Continue sampling after EOS; the experiment token cap still applies.

name: stop_token_ids
description: Token IDs that stop generation. Add tokenizer-verified candidates before allowing changes.

name: allowed_token_ids
description: Restrict sampling to verified token IDs; an empty allowlist is invalid.

name: logit_bias
description: Token ID to logit offset. Reviewed groups: sentence-initial hesitation and switching words, which reasoning models use to double back, and the end of the thinking block.

entries.label: Lower the odds of hesitation words (Wait, Hmm) by 1
Lower the odds of hesitation words (Wait, Hmm) by 2
Lower the odds of hesitation words (Wait, Hmm) by 4
Lower the odds of hesitation words (Wait, Hmm) by 8
Lower the odds of switching words (But, Alternatively, Actually, Maybe) by 1
Lower the odds of switching words (But, Alternatively, Actually, Maybe) by 2
Lower the odds of switching words (But, Alternatively, Actually, Maybe) by 4
Lower the odds of switching words (But, Alternatively, Actually, Maybe) by 8
Raise the odds of the end of the thinking block (</think>) by 4
Raise the odds of the end of the thinking block (</think>) by 8

Raise the odds of the end of the thinking block (</think>) by 16

name: output_kind
description: Native request-output representation; not an answer-quality control.

name: logprobs
description: Observation-only output log probabilities; not a quality control.

name: prompt_logprobs
description: Observation-only prompt log probabilities; not a quality control.

name: min_tokens
description: Minimum generated tokens before stopping, restricted to zero or one so it remains valid for short segments.

name: detokenize
description: Return decoded text alongside generated token IDs; output representation only.

name: skip_special_tokens
description: Omit special tokens when decoding output text; output representation only.

name: spaces_between_special_tokens
description: Insert spaces between adjacent special tokens in decoded output; output representation only.

name: include_stop_str_in_output
description: Whether decoded output includes the stop string; only relevant when a stop string is configured.

name: flat_logprobs
description: Return log probabilities in a flattened representation; observation only.

name: bad_words
description: Words that must not be generated (a hard ban; each is blocked with and without a leading space).

name: repetition_detection
description: End the segment when a token pattern repeats (finish reason repetition); the run continues from there.

presets.label: Detect short loops: a 2-8 token pattern repeated 4 times
Detect phrase loops: a 5-30 token pattern repeated 3 times
Detect long loops: a 10-100 token pattern repeated 3 times
Detect strictly: a 5-30 token pattern repeated 2 times
